articles.summary: Your best data engineers should build, not migrate. Don’t bury them in SQL rewrites, and start treating migrations like modern software projects.
articles.title: What could your smartest data engineer be doing instead of a 6-month data migration?

articles.summary: Migrations are hard, but edge cases make them impossible. Every team we spoke to at Gartner had the same struggle: migrations stall because traditional automation can’t handle the weird, unpredictable mess of legacy systems. AI changes the game by understanding context, learning from feedback, and adapting to complexity in ways static tools never could.
articles.title: Every migration is an edge case nightmare. Can AI break the deadlock?
